about_the_game:
When the Embers Wake is a third-person narrative adventure game where you play as a young Red Panda looking to survive amidst ongoing threats to the environment and wildlife.​

Game Features

  • Third person exploration/walking simulator through the eyes of a red panda

  • Wordless storytelling through animation and environment

  • Hand-crafted environments to explore

  • Meaningful interactions with wildlife and nature

  • 2-hour intimate narrative experience

  • Available on PC & Steam Deck​

Gameplay

A gentle, contemplative experience focused on exploration and emotional discovery

🌲Explore

Wander through hand-crafted environments that tell their own stories through visual details and atmospheric design.

🐾Interact

Connect with animals, objects, and natural elements in meaningful ways that advance the narrative without words.

✨Experience

Immerse yourself in a story that goes through the different life stages of a red panda, experiencing the new reality of the forest

Themes

Explore profound themes through gentle, wordless storytelling

💔Grief

Navigate the complex emotions of loss through a young red panda's journey of understanding and acceptance.

🌲Deforestation

Witness the impact of environmental change on wildlife habitats and the creatures that call them home.

🦔Animal Survival

Experience the resilience and adaptability of wildlife in the face of an ever-changing world.

💪Emotional Resilience

Discover the quiet strength that emerges from vulnerability and the courage to continue despite loss.

🌅Hope

Find light in the darkness and learn that even in endings, there can be new beginnings.

🤔💭Choice

​Will you help the other animals? or will you persevere on your own?

​​

Will the embers take the forest?

name: When the Embers Wake

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-3470 or AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750, 2GB or AMD
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: When the Embers Wake is a third person narrative adventure with a cause to create awareness about the very current and real threats on wildlife. You play as a red panda that needs to survive amidst environmental challenges, threats and also grief.
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Arabic, Bulgarian, Czech, Danish, Dutch, Finnish, Greek, Hungarian, Indonesian, Japanese, Korean, Norwegian, Polish, Portuguese - Brazil, Portuguese - Portugal, Romanian, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Spanish - Latin America, Swedish, Thai, Traditional Chinese, Turkish, Ukrainian, Vietnamese
